summary: Lassen NF lookout: Red River Lumber Co. built the first tower in 1913; a 1984 Cal Fire tower stands on the peak, and the old lookout was moved to the Lassen County Fairgrounds.

facts.design: 1984 Cal Fire structure, prefabricated and put together with prison inmate labor; cab based on the 73 2-6A plan; tower similar to Plan 1558
facts.status_note: NHLR lists the 1984 tower as the current structure; the latest staffing note I found is 2016 and no later condition report was found

staffing.status: staffed by Lassen National Forest as of 2016

facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection, Lassen-Modoc Unit (Cal Fire LMU)

events.note: Red River Lumber Company built the first lookout, packing materials to the site by horse
NHLR: the Lassen National Forest constructed a new lookout in the 1920s; year is the decade only
Cal Fire removed the old lookout and replaced it with a new structure
old lookout dismantled and shipped to Smokey Bear Park at the Lassen County Fairgrounds; Lassen News dates the removal to 1984; NHLR says the 1920s lookout went there
NHLR: a replica was constructed and on display at the fairgrounds as of 2008
NHLR: the Lassen National Forest was staffing the lookout as of 2016; Peakbagging photo of June 7, 2016 notes the same staffing
restoration of the fairgrounds lookout began June 16, 2023 (new roof, rebuilt and repainted tower and cab); ribbon cutting and reopening set for July 22, 2023

corrections.current: None relocated (The lookout was moved to the Susanville Fairgrounds.)
corrections.proposed: 1984: the old lookout was dismantled and moved to Smokey Bear Park at the Lassen County Fairgrounds
corrections.why: The brief's own note says the lookout was moved, so 'None relocated' contradicts it. Lassen News dates the removal to 1984. NHLR says the 1920s lookout went to the fairgrounds, so which building went there is disputed; see resolved_conflicts.

resolved_conflicts.field: which lookout is at the fairgrounds, and when it moved
resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says the 1920s lookout was removed to the fairgrounds and a replica was on display by 2008. Lassen News says Cal Fire removed the old lookout, in service since 1913, in 1984, dismantled it and reassembled it at the fairgrounds; the restored tower there is called the old lookout. Peakbagging says the building removed from the site is now at the fairgrounds. The story reports these without choosing one.

notes_for_editor: No source after 2016 on the mountain tower, so its current condition is unverified. The brief's source_pages entry '../us-ca-pegleg-mountain-at-susanville-fairgrounds/' is a broken relative link (the NHLR address returns 404), so it was not used. A CAL FIRE LMU Facebook post, seen only as a search snippet and not read, gives 1985 for the dismantling; that date is not cited, so the move is recorded as 1984 from Lassen News. The 1913 versus 1920s question about which building went to the fairgrounds is unresolved. Access to the mountain tower is not covered by any source, so no access key is given. Used 5 page reads (one returned 404) and 1 search.
